from the 20th, billing packs for accounts departments, dealers and a Billing section, tests for AI agents before they go live, AI agents that use a client's own tools, and 13 Partner Academy courses.

Billing cycle from the 20th to the 19th: billing now runs from the 20th of one month to the 19th of the next, for the platform, resellers and their clients. The move starts with a short, prorated bridge from 1 to 19 November; statements and billing screens follow the new cycle.

Billing packs: an accounts department can receive the cycle's billing as an Excel workbook on a schedule, for a reseller, the platform or one organisation, or send and download it at any time. The download link lasts an hour.

Dealers and the Billing section: a reseller can now have dealers who sell to its clients. The reseller sets a dealer's price list, whose fee and allowances count once per dealer across all its clients, and dealers see what they earn but never the reseller's own cost. A client can be billed by its reseller or directly by the platform; a platform-billed client comes off the reseller's invoice, and the reseller gets an earnings statement instead. A billing-only sign-in opens a new Billing section in the console for operators, resellers and dealers, with profit and loss, trends over 12 cycles and graphs. Billing-only users see billing and nothing else.

AI agent tests: on the AI agents page, a Tests tab holds conversations the agent must handle, with what it should and should not say. Runs talk to a test copy of the agent and judge each answer. Once an agent has tests, Publish runs them first and only publishes when they pass.

AI agents with the client's own tools: an organisation can connect its own MCP servers on a new MCP servers page and switch on the tools an AI agent may use during a call. A tool that changes something asks the caller to confirm first; customer details stay masked as elsewhere; and the tools in use are kept with each published version. It is a plan feature, off unless the plan includes it.

Partner Academy, 13 courses: three Sales levels, six specialisations and four Technical courses, each with its own exam, real questions and a certificate, and full-length walkthrough videos. Certificates earned before keep their grace period.

Fixes: under My work on the agent desk, a ticket opens that ticket, and the whole row opens it in My tickets. An organisation can have the desk set available agents to Screen locked while their workstation is locked, and back to available when they unlock it. A special day can say no schedules, and Build schedule plans no shifts on it or on public holidays. On the Missed calls page, searching a caller's number shows which agents were idle, on a call, on a break or in disposition when each call joined its queue. A ticket now goes to the agent who takes its customer's reply from the queue, so the email and the ticket are no longer split between two agents.

Before you update: on a two-site (Ultra HA) installation, do not create billing-only reseller users until both sites run this release, because the older release treats them as full administrators. Moving a single organisation to another reseller removes its dealer, so set the dealer again after such a move."}
